Name: Cuter Fatter Farm
Author: SqueakGames
Description: Ever wanted to pack your AT modpack with cute and fat animals? Tired of converting mods yourself to AT to delete them in 9 days? Fear no more! This is a the AT version of Cuter Fatter Strawberry Cow and Yellow Duckies made by Salty Catpuccino! Now with the cuter fatter livestock mods from IdentityPolution, including a little Easter Egg! Hope you like my little mod!

Downloads.Description: Added a texture to the golden chickens and fixed a bug with the white cow textures!
